name: Picture stage
responsibility: Owns the canvas of one surface and its painter, hands the painter what the page says, and asks the frame clock for frames only while something moves
description: Until the painter's first frame the surface shows the SVG with its ink, and a painter that cannot start leaves it so: a correct picture. The SVG stays in the page under the canvas as the hidden semantic layer that search, copy, screen readers and the marks read, written by picture-transition.ts. picture-ink.ts keeps a first picture's ink back for a moment so that the painter brings the picture in. React gives the stage a host, and the stage makes each canvas inside it, so a painter that fails is released and a replacement gets a fresh canvas. picture-ink.ts then gives the SVG back the glyphs and definitions that a painted surface dropped, so complete ink shows while the replacement starts. The surface says which painter draws in data-painter, and why WebGPU and WebGL2 do not in data-painter-reason.
